votes.sql:
WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.heading_accuracy
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN latest_attr la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE la.heading_accuracy >= 80;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.heading_accuracy >= 75

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(heading_accuracy) AS max_head_acc
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.max_head_acc > 80;

questions.nlq: Find all players whose shooting skill rating exceeds the league median and return their names along with the specific attribute measurement.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When referring to shooting skill, I mean the finishing attribute which measures a player's accuracy and success rate when attempting to score goals from close range.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH MedianCalc AS (
    SELECT AVG(finishing) AS median_value
    FROM (
        SELECT finishing
        FROM Player_Attributes
        ORDER BY finishing
        LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes) % 2
        OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM Player_Attributes)
    )
)
SELECT p.player_name, pa.finishing
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN MedianCalc
WHERE pa.finishing > MedianCalc.median_value

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When referring to shooting skill, I mean the shot power attribute which measures how forcefully a player can strike the ball when taking a shot.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH median_calc AS (
    SELECT shot_power 
    FROM Player_Attributes 
    ORDER BY shot_power
),
median_val AS (
    SELECT AVG(shot_power) as median_shot_power
    FROM (
        SELECT shot_power 
        FROM median_calc 
        LIMIT 2-(SELECT COUNT(*) % 2 FROM median_calc)
        OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM median_calc) / 2
    )
)
SELECT p.player_name, pa.shot_power
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN median_val m
WHERE pa.shot_power > m.median_shot_power

questions.nlq: For every player who participated in at least three matches during the 2008/2009 season, provide the average passing score and the total number of goals the player scored in those matches.

WITH player_match AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id,
         m.home_team_goal AS team_goal,
         hp.player_api_id AS player_id
  FROM "Match" m
  JOIN (
    SELECT id AS match_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"

    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"

    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
  ) hp ON m.id = hp.match_id
  WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.id AS match_id,
         m.away_team_goal AS team_goal,
         ap.player_api_id AS player_id
  FROM "Match" m
  JOIN (
    SELECT id AS match_id, away_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"

    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
  ) ap ON m.id = ap.match_id

),

  SELECT player_id

FROM player_match pm

questions.nlq: Could you show me the most recent passing ratings for teams competing in the England Premier League?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: By passing ratings, I am interested in the metric that defines the team's preference for short, mixed, or long passes during the build-up phase.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
    ta.team_api_id,
    ta.buildUpPlayPassing
FROM Team_Attributes ta
INNER JOIN Match m ON (ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR ta.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id)
INNER JOIN League le ON m.league_id = le.id
WHERE le.name = 'England Premier League'
AND ta.date = (
    SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
    INNER JOIN Match m2 ON (ta2.team_api_id = m2.home_team_api_id OR ta2.team_api_id = m2.away_team_api_id)
    INNER JOIN League le2 ON m2.league_id = le2.id
    WHERE le2.name = 'England Premier League'
    AND ta2.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
)

meanings.hidden_knowledge: By passing ratings, I am interested in the metric that evaluates the risk involved in passing when trying to create scoring opportunities.

SELECT DISTINCT ta.chanceCreationPassing
FROM Team_Attributes ta
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    INNER JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    INNER JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
) pl_teams ON ta.team_api_id = pl_teams.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date = (
    SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
    WHERE ta2.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
)

FROM (

    FROM Player_Attributes
) pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.rn = 1;

SELECT attacking_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes;

JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL;
